limitations: The ordinary power-norm characterization is classical Wallen and is not claimed as new. The fresh audit found no source stating the simultaneous ordinary/essential power-norm realization with irreducibility or the exact-rate consequence. The complete 1974 Shields survey could not be inspected, so equivalent older coverage under different weighted-shift terminology remains a residual originality risk.
provenance: A recurrent-prefix modification of Wallen's weighted-shift realization repeats each norming prefix arbitrarily far out while positive bridge weights preserve all submultiplicative upper bounds, forcing the same prescribed values in operator norm and essential norm.
record_title: Exact norm and essential-norm power profiles for irreducible weighted shifts
